text.duckNoMusic: Add a music track first. A track named Music is picked up by itself.
text.duckNoVoice: Put a voice or dialogue clip on its own audio track so the music has something to duck under.
text.capsNoWords: No spoken words were found on this track.
text.capEmpty: A caption cannot be empty. Delete it instead.
text.pickLookStrength: Pick a look first, then set how strong it is.
text.pickLookAll: Pick a look or change a setting first, then apply it to all clips.
text.titleWordsFirst: Type the words for the title first.
text.titleNeedsWords: A title needs some words. The old words are kept.
text.titleStyleSame: The title already has that style.
text.noteReverse: Plays backwards. Change it on desktop.
text.animated: This is animated, so it can only be changed on desktop.
text.onlyFit: Only a clip on a picture track can be fitted.
text.alreadyFills: The picture already fills the frame.
text.onlyMove: Only a clip on a picture track can be moved.
text.onlyPlace: Only a clip on a picture track has a place in the frame.
text.typeNumber: Type a number. The old value is kept.
text.onlyOpacity: Only a clip on a picture track has opacity.

fmt.rotated: Rotated {degrees} degrees{animated, select, yes { (animated on desktop)} other {}}. Change it on desktop.
fmt.fixRange: {label} is between {min} and {max}. The old value is kept.
fmt.sizeRange: Size is between {min}% and {max}%. The old value is kept.
fmt.positionRange: Position is between -{limit}% and {limit}%. The old value is kept.
fmt.captionsAdded: {count, plural, one {# caption added.} other {# captions added.}}
fmt.moveFrames: {label}: {direction, select, later {later} other {earlier}} by {count, plural, one {# frame} other {# frames}}
fmt.nudgeFrames: Move {direction, select, later {later} other {earlier}} by {count, plural, one {# frame} other {# frames}}
fmt.changesApplied: {count, plural, one {# change applied} other {# changes applied}}
fmt.noneSelected: No clip selected, {count, plural, one {# clip} other {# clips}}
fmt.clipOf: Clip {n} of {total}, {name}, {from} to {to}{more, plural, =0 {} one {, and # more selected} other {, and # more selected}}
fmt.clipOfOn: Clip {n} of {total} on {track}, {name}, {from} to {to}{more, plural, =0 {} one {, and # more selected} other {, and # more selected}}
fmt.scaleEdge: Stretch picture from the {edge, select, t {top} r {right} b {bottom} other {left}} edge
fmt.scaleCorner: Scale picture from the {corner, select, tl {top left} tr {top right} br {bottom right} other {bottom left}} corner
fmt.addedToCuts: {count, plural, one {Added to # cut} other {Added to # cuts}}
fmt.noSpareFootage: {count, plural, one {# cut has no spare footage; use Make room on it.} other {# cuts have no spare footage; use Make room on them.}}
